# Vendor

- `glyph-rain.js` — [Canvas UI](https://canvasui.dev) Glyph Rain vanilla runtime
  (`createGlyphRain` / `supportsHtmlInCanvas` from DavidHDev/canvas-ui).
  MIT License. Used for the GitHub Pages background effect.

Full light-on-content mode needs Chrome's html-in-canvas API (origin trial
or flag). Without it, rain still renders as a WebGL overlay and content stays
normal HTML.
